* HUB（枢纽）
* INTERFACE（接口）
* LOAD（负荷节点）
* RESIDUAL_METERED_EDC（剩余计量配电公司）
* ZONE（区域）

description: Real-Time unverified locational marginal pricing (LMP) data for all bus locations.
description_chinese: 所有母线位置的实时未验证节点边际电价（LMP）数据。

description: Real time PJM load across each zone, region, and RTO total in 5 minute intervals.
description_chinese: PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）各区域、地区以及RTO（区域输电组织）总计的实时负荷，数据间隔为5分钟。

description:
PJM hourly load forecast for the next seven days resampled to 5 minute intervals.

- Only includes data from the most recent published vintage for each interval
- Only includes data for the combined RTO (not individual forecast areas)
description_chinese:
PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）未来七天的小时级负荷预测，重采样至5分钟间隔。

- 仅包含每个时间间隔最近一期发布的数据。
- 仅包含RTO（区域输电组织）整体的数据（不包含单个预测区域）。

description: Five-minute load forecast data showing forecast amounts every five minutes for a two hour window by area. This forecast is updated every five minutes. The data is presented for 25 areas to maintain consistency with the seven day load forecasts
description_chinese: 五分钟负荷预测数据，按区域显示未来两小时窗口内每五分钟的预测值。此预测每五分钟更新一次。数据按25个区域呈现，以与七天负荷预测保持一致。

description:
PJM hourly load forecast for the next seven days by region and zone.

- Includes all published vintages.
- Published every half hour on the quarter E.g. 1:15 and 1:45
- Includes data for all forecast areas.
- Data available at https://dataminer2.pjm.com/feed/load_frcstd_7_day/definition.
- For more history use `load_forecast_hourly_historical` (note the historical dataset does not contain all the forecast areas as the current dataset does)
description_chinese:
PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）按地区和区域划分的未来七天小时级负荷预测。

- 包含所有已发布的版本。
- 每半小时在整点过15分和45分发布（例如1:15和1:45）。
- 包含所有预测区域的数据。
- 数据可在 https://dataminer2.pjm.com/feed/load_frcstd_7_day/definition 获取。
- 如需更多历史数据，请使用 load_forecast_hourly_historical（请注意，历史数据集不包含与当前数据集一样多的预测区域）。

description:
This feed provides forecasted load, grouped by the date and time the forecast
was created. Forecasts are provided every six hours starting one day prior to the
Effective Date.

- Includes all published vintages
- Includes data for all forecast areas
- For additional forecast areas and publish times for recent dates, use
    `load_forecast_hourly`
- Data available at https://dataminer2.pjm.com/feed/load_frcstd_hist/definition
description_chinese:
此数据源提供按预测创建日期和时间分组的预测负荷。预测从生效日期前一天开始，每六小时提供一次。

- 包含所有已发布的版本。
- 包含所有预测区域的数据。
- 如需近期日期的更多预测区域和发布时间，请使用 load_forecast_hourly。
- 数据可在 https://dataminer2.pjm.com/feed/load_frcstd_hist/definition 获取。

description: The MWh net energy consumption by each service territory within PJM. Data is further broken up into NERC region, zone, and load areas.
description_chinese: PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）内每个服务区域的总净电能消耗（兆瓦时）。数据进一步按NERC区域、区域和负荷区进行细分。

description: PJM estimates marginal emissions every five minutes for load zones across the grid. These estimates include CO₂, SO₂, and NOₓ, expressed in lbs/MWh. The calculation reflects the physical costs of power flows, capturing the impact of congestion on nodal emissions. When imports are marginal at a node, PJM assigns them zero emissions because the fuel source is unknown. PJM notes several caveats in its data catalog due to the complexity and variability of the underlying data. These emissions estimates, along with PJM’s own disclaimers, are discussed in more detail in this blog post: https://blog.gridstatus.io/apple-grid-forecast/
description_chinese: PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）每五分钟估算一次全电网负荷区的边际排放率。这些估算包括CO₂、SO₂和NOₓ，单位为磅/兆瓦时（lbs/MWh）。该计算反映了功率流的物理成本，捕捉了阻塞对节点排放的影响。当节点上边际出力来自外部进口时，PJM将其排放率归为零，因为燃料来源未知。PJM在其数据目录中指出了若干注意事项，原因是基础数据具有复杂性和可变性。关于这些排放估算以及PJM自身的免责声明，详见此博客文章：https://blog.gridstatus.io/apple-grid-forecast/

description: Day-ahead binding constraint data for PJM. This includes the contingency and the shadow price, or marginal value of 1 MW of relaxation.
description_chinese: PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）的日前约束数据。包括故障事件及其影子价格，即放松1兆瓦约束的边际价值。

description:
Real-time binding constraint data for PJM. This includes the contingency and the shadow price, or marginal value of 1 MW of relaxation.

This dataset is the 5-minute feed which began on April 1st, 2018.
description_chinese:
PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）的实时绑定约束数据。这包括事故和影子价格，即放松1兆瓦约束的边际价值。

此数据集是自2018年4月1日开始提供的5分钟数据源。

description: This dataset contains the hourly difference between generation and load in each of PJM’s 13 states as well as Washington, DC. Negative values indicate net flows into the state whereas positive indicate exports. This dataset does not account for actual power flows.
description_chinese: 该数据集包含PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）覆盖的13个州以及华盛顿特区每小时发电量与负荷之间的差值。负值表示净电力流入该州，正值表示净出口。此数据集不涉及实际电力潮流。

description:
This dataset contains operating reserve values in MWs in PJM for the entire
RTO and Mid-Atlantic/Dominion region and is updated every 15 seconds.

Values are included for the Primary Reserve Requirement, Total, and
Requirement from Markets; the Synchronized Reserve Requirement, Total,
and Requirement from Markets; and the 30-Minute Total and Requirement
from Markets.

⚠️ PJM does not typically backfill this data series in the event of data drops.
description_chinese:
该数据集包含PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）整个RTO（区域输电组织）以及中大西洋/道明尼地区的运行备用数值（单位为兆瓦），每15秒更新一次。

数据包括：一次备用需求、总量及来自市场的需求；同步备用需求、总量及来自市场的需求；以及三十分钟备用总量及来自市场的需求。

⚠️ 在数据丢失的情况下，PJM通常不会补填此数据系列。

description: Forecast total MWs of generation on outage in PJM, including the West region, out 90 days. Unlike the dataset [here](https://staging.preview.gridstatus.io/datasets/pjm_outages_daily), this forecast from PJM does not separate out the type of outages and lacks additional location classifications.
description_chinese: PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）未来90天内（包括西部地区）停运发电容量的预测总兆瓦值。与 此处 的数据集不同，此PJM预测数据没有区分停运类型，也缺少其他位置分类。

description:
PJM generation outage data

Actual and forecasted megawatts of generation outages divided by region (RTO Wide, Mid-A/Dominion, and Western) and type of outage(Planned, Maintenance, and Forced). Bal-Day data is typically updated around 6AM ET and is forecasted out 6 days.
description_chinese:
PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）发电停运数据

按区域（RTO全域、中大西洋/道明尼和西部）和停运类型（计划、维护和强制）划分的实际和预测发电停运兆瓦数。当日（Bal-Day）数据通常在美国东部时间早上6点左右更新，并预测未来6天的情况。

description: This dataset summarizes the status of Performance Assessment Intervals (PAIs) in PJM. A PAI is a specific time interval during which emergency conditions on the PJM system require operators to call on resources that participate in the capacity market. Resources are evaluated on their performance during these intervals and may receive penalties or bonuses based on how they perform. PAIs are relatively rare, but when one is issued, PJM identifies whether it applies to a specific subzone or the entire RTO.
description_chinese: 该数据集汇总了PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）中性能评估间隔（PAIs）的状态。PAI是指PJM系统出现紧急状况，需要运营商调用参与容量市场的资源的特定时间间隔。PJM根据资源在这些间隔期间的表现进行评估，并可能根据其表现给予惩罚或奖励。PAIs相对罕见，但一旦发布，PJM会指明其适用于特定子区域还是整个RTO（区域输电组织）。

description: This dataset contains all pricing nodes modeled across PJM. PJM calculates locational marginal prices for each of these points, representing generation, load, and aggregations like hubs and zones. Additionally, this dataset includes information such as voltage level, transmission zone, subtypes, and when the node was created.
description_chinese: 该数据集包含PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）中建模的所有定价节点。PJM为这些节点计算节点边际电价（LMP），这些节点代表发电节点、负荷节点以及枢纽和区域等聚合点。此外，该数据集还包括电压等级、输电区域、子类型以及节点创建时间等信息。

description:
Projected Area Statistics at Peak

This data is prepared each morning and contains information for the projected peak of the day for zones within the PJM footprint, including peak load, internal scheduled capacity, and unscheduled steam capacity. Data is refreshed on top of the hour from 5 a.m. to 8 a.m.
description_chinese:
峰值时预测区域统计数据

此数据每天上午编制，包含PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）覆盖范围内各区域在当日预测峰值时的信息，包括峰值负荷、内部计划容量和非计划蒸汽容量。数据从凌晨5点到上午8点在整点时刻刷新。

description: This dataset contains scheduled tie flows at each of PJM’s interfaces during the peak hour, updated each morning.
description_chinese: 该数据集包含PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）每个接口在峰值小时期间的计划联络线潮流，每天上午更新。

description: This data is prepared each morning and contains information for the projected peak of the day for the entire PJM footprint. PJM publishes scheduled tie flows, total scheduled capacity, peak load forecast, operational reserves, and unscheduled steam capacity. Data is refreshed on top of the hour from 5 a.m. to 8 a.m.
description_chinese: 此数据每天上午编制，包含PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）整个覆盖区域当日预测峰值时的信息。PJM发布的指标包括计划联络线潮流、总计划容量、峰值负荷预测、运行备用和非计划蒸汽容量。数据从凌晨5点到上午8点在整点时刻刷新。

description: Top 10 daily records in PJM. Records including minimum and maximum net load levels, record levels of RTO wide wind and solar generation, and the renewables to load ratio.
description_chinese: PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）内的每日前十名记录。记录包括净负荷的最低和最高水平、RTO（区域输电组织）整体风电和太阳能发电的记录水平，以及可再生能源与负荷的比率。

description: Timeline of new records in PJM covering renewables and net load since 2016.
description_chinese: PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）内自2016年以来涵盖可再生能源和净负荷的新记录时间线。

description:
Hourly regulation capacity requirements in PJM. Mileage ratios and performance data are also included. 

This data is posted monthly on the first Friday of the month, but due to its reliance on settlement data may be delayed based on delays in the settlement process.
description_chinese:
PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）中的小时级调频容量要求。数据中还包含里程比和性能数据。

此数据每月在第一个星期五发布，但由于其依赖于结算数据，可能会因结算过程的延迟而推迟发布。

description: The dataset contains preliminary five minute quantity, requirement, and prices PJM RTO wide. Regulation resources are compensated for adjusting their consumption or generation in response to grid frequency needs.
description_chinese: 该数据集包含PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）RTO（区域输电组织）范围内的初步五分钟调频数量、要求和价格。调频资源因响应电网频率需求而调整其消耗或发电量获得补偿。

description: Reserve mappings (not geographic) for PJM reserves as well as resource id, type, and zone.
description_chinese: PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）备用的映射关系（非地理映射），以及资源ID、类型和区域信息。

description: Reserve subzone mapping (not geographic location) for PJM reserves. This dataset also contains node id, name, and the type of resource.
description_chinese: PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）备用的备用子区域映射（非地理位置）。该数据集还包含节点ID、名称和资源类型。

description: Hourly scheduled net real time tie flows between PJM and nearby balancing authorities. This data its released daily for the prior day. Positive values indicate imports and negative values represent exports.
description_chinese: PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）与相邻平衡区域之间的小时级计划净实时联络线潮流。此数据每天发布，针对前一日。正值表示进口，负值表示出口。

description:
Verified, real-time, five-minute LMPs, including component costs, for the aggregate and zonal pnodes used for settlement in PJM.

Residual aggregate and loadweighted transmission zone prices are PJM estimates.
description_chinese:
PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）中用于结算的聚合点物理节点和区域物理节点的已验证实时五分钟节点边际电价（LMP），包含分量成本。

剩余聚合价格和按负荷加权的输电区域价格为PJM的估计值。

description:
Verified, hourly, LMPs for both day-ahead and real-time including component costs, for the aggregate and zonal pnodes used for settlement in PJM.

The location types present are:

- *ZONE*
- *RESIDUAL_METERED_EDC*
- *HUB*
- *AGGREGATE*
- *INTERFACE*
- *EHV*
description_chinese:
PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）中用于结算的聚合点物理节点和区域物理节点的已验证小时级节点边际电价（LMP），包含日前和实时数据，且包含分量成本。

存在的位置类型包括：

- ZONE（区域）
- RESIDUAL_METERED_EDC（剩余计量配电公司）
- HUB（枢纽）
- AGGREGATE（聚合点）
- INTERFACE（接口）
- EHV（超高压节点）

description:
Five-minute solar power forecast within PJM.

The five-minute power forecast within PJM area for metered utility scale solar power and behind-the-meter solar power such as residential solar panels. Behind The Meter (BTM) solar power is aggregated and handled through Load Serving Entities (LSE), not directly through PJM. Updated every 10 minutes, forecasting the next 6 hours. It is available for the previous 30 days.
description_chinese:
PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）内的五分钟太阳能发电预测。

该预测针对PJM区域内计量表后的公用事业规模太阳能发电以及表后太阳能发电（如住宅太阳能电池板）。表后太阳能发电通过负荷服务实体（LSE）进行聚合处理，而非直接通过PJM。该预测每10分钟更新一次，预测未来6小时的情况，并提供过去30天的数据。

description:
Hourly solar power forecast within PJM

The hourly power forecast within PJM area for metered- utility scale solar power
and behind the meter solar power such as residential solar panels. Behind The Meter
(BTM) solar power is aggregated and handled through Load Serving Entities (LSE),
not directly through PJM. The forecast is updated every hour and is available for
the next 48 hours.
description_chinese:
PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）内的小时级太阳能发电预测。

该预测针对PJM区域内计量表后的公用事业规模太阳能发电以及表后太阳能发电（如住宅太阳能电池板）。表后太阳能发电通过负荷服务实体（LSE）进行聚合处理，而非直接通过PJM。该预测每小时更新一次，并提供未来48小时的预测数据。

description:
Five-minute real-time solar generation for the PJM RTO area.

⚠️ PJM does not backfill this data series in the event of data drops.
description_chinese:
PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）RTO（区域输电组织）区域的五分钟实时太阳能发电数据。

⚠️ 在数据丢失的情况下，PJM不会补填此数据系列。

description:
Solar generation by Area in PJM on an hourly basis. Areas include *MIDATL*, *Other*, *RFC*, *RTO*, *South*, and *West*. The *Other* region contains external units as well as units for which the region/area is unknown.

Final data for this dataset is delayed by up to 4 months. Prior to updating with final data, PJM may provide both 0 and negative values.
description_chinese:
PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）内按区域划分的小时级太阳能发电量。区域包括 MIDATL、Other、RFC、RTO、South 和 West。Other 区域包含外部机组以及区域/地区未知的机组。

此数据集的最终数据延迟最多4个月。在更新为最终数据之前，PJM可能会提供0值和负值。

description:
This table is a curated set of five-minute data for PJM. All standardized datasets are intended to speed up analysis and feature engineering work by providing commonly used data series in one denormalized table.

Metrics include:

- Load Forecasts (Regional, Zonal, and RTO-Wide)
- Renewable Generation
- Load Ratios (Net load levels, Renewable to load ratios)
- Wind and Solar Output
- Generation by fuel type (Coal, Gas, Hydro, Multiple Fuels, Nuclear, Oil, Solar, Storage, Wind, Other, and Other Renewable)

The standardized datasets are a convenience for API users who only want to query one dataset for each ISO. If you plan on loading in every dataset or want to work with more multiple series alone and together it is recommended to pull the individual datasets to have full visibility into each one.

⚠️ Not all data series are present for the entire length of the dataset. This can occur due to a lack of historical data or the publication of new core datasets by an ISO.
description_chinese:
此表格是PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）经过精选的五分钟数据集合。所有标准化数据集旨在通过在一个非规范化表中提供常用的数据系列，来加速分析和特征工程工作。

指标包括：

- 负荷预测（区域级、区域级和RTO全域）
- 可再生能源发电量
- 负荷比率（净负荷水平、可再生能源与负荷比率）
- 风电和太阳能出力
- 按燃料类型划分的发电量（煤、天然气、水力、多燃料、核能、石油、太阳能、储能、风能、其他和其他可再生能源）

标准化数据集是为API用户提供的便利，方便他们只需查询每个ISO的一个数据集即可。如果您计划加载所有数据集，或希望单独或组合使用多个数据系列，建议拉取各个独立的数据集，以便完全了解每个数据集的详情。

⚠️ 并非所有数据系列在整个数据集的时间范围内都存在。这可能是由于历史数据缺失或ISO发布了新的核心数据集所致。

description:
This table is a curated set of hourly data for PJM. All standardized datasets are intended to speed up analysis and feature engineering work by providing commonly used data series in one denormalized table. Data in this feed is resampled to an hourly frequency from five minutes.

Metrics include:

- Load Forecasts (Regional, Zonal, and RTO-Wide)
- Renewable Generation
- Load Ratios (Net load levels, Renewable to load ratios)
- Wind and Solar Output
- Generation by fuel type (Coal, Gas, Hydro, Multiple Fuels, Nuclear, Oil, Solar, Storage, Wind, Other, and Other Renewable)

The standardized datasets are a convenience for API users who only want to query one dataset for each ISO. If you plan on loading in every dataset or want to work with more multiple series alone and together it is recommended to pull the individual datasets to have full visibility into each one.

⚠️ Not all data series are present for the entire length of the dataset. This can occur due to a lack of historical data or the publication of new core datasets by an ISO.
description_chinese:
此表格是PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）经过精选的小时级数据集合。所有标准化数据集旨在通过在一个非规范化表中提供常用的数据系列，来加速分析和特征工程工作。此数据源中的数据是从五分钟频率重采样为小时频率。

指标包括：

- 负荷预测（区域级、区域级和RTO全域）
- 可再生能源发电量
- 负荷比率（净负荷水平、可再生能源与负荷比率）
- 风电和太阳能出力
- 按燃料类型划分的发电量（煤、天然气、水力、多燃料、核能、石油、太阳能、储能、风能、其他和其他可再生能源）

标准化数据集是为API用户提供的便利，方便他们只需查询每个ISO的一个数据集即可。如果您计划加载所有数据集，或希望单独或组合使用多个数据系列，建议拉取各个独立的数据集，以便完全了解每个数据集的详情。

⚠️ 并非所有数据系列在整个数据集的时间范围内都存在。这可能是由于历史数据缺失或ISO发布了新的核心数据集所致。

description: This dataset contains the history of declared synchronized reserve events in PJM, including the time, location, and percentage of reserves deployed.
description_chinese: 该数据集包含PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）中已宣布的同步备用事件的历史记录，包括时间、地点和已部署备用的百分比。

description:
Tie flows (power flows) between PJM and neighboring control areas. Positive values are for net megawatt (MW) flows into PJM, while negative values are for net MW flows out of PJM. Hourly averages, with more historical data, can be found using the PJM Actual And Scheduled Interchange Summary datset.

For additional history at an hourly granularity, see [PJM Actual And Scheduled Interchange Summary](https://www.gridstatus.io/datasets/pjm_actual_and_scheduled_interchange_summary).
description_chinese:
PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）与相邻控制区之间的联络线潮流（功率潮流）。正值表示净兆瓦（MW）功率流入PJM，负值表示净兆瓦功率流出PJM。小时平均值及更多历史数据可通过PJM实际与计划交换汇总数据集获取。

如需更详细的小时粒度历史数据，请参阅PJM实际与计划交换汇总。

description:
Actual MW flow and transfer limits for PJM’s Transfer Interfaces. This data
is reported on a five-minute basis. These interfaces are internal to PJM.
Each interface is comprised of a set of transmission lines defined in
*PJM Manual 03: Transmission Operations*.

⚠️ PJM does not typically backfill this data series in the event of data drops.
description_chinese:
PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）传输接口的实际兆瓦功率和传输限值。该数据按五分钟间隔报告。这些接口位于PJM内部。每个接口由一组在PJM手册03：输电运行中定义的输电线路组成。

⚠️ 如果发生数据丢失，PJM通常不会回填该数据系列。

description: Hourly average of transfer limits and flows across PJM’s internal interfaces. PJM releases this data on a monthly basis. For more real time data, use the PJM Transfer Interface Information 5 Min dataset.
description_chinese: PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）内部接口传输限值和潮流的每小时平均值。PJM每月发布一次此数据。如需更实时的数据，请使用PJM传输接口信息5分钟数据集。

description:
Day-ahead transmission constraint data in PJM with congestion event start and end times as well as the number of 5 minute prints within the hour. 

This dataset does not contain shadow prices.
description_chinese:
PJM（宾夕法尼亚-新泽西-马里兰联合电力系统）的日前输电约束数据，包含阻塞事件的开始和结束时间，以及该小时内五分钟出清结果的次数。

此数据集不包含影子价格。

description:
This dataset contains transmission limits as well as the shadow price in PJM for every actively binding constraint within a five-minute interval.

Included in the data is the type of constraint violation (thermal, actual, and reactive interface) as well as the contingency that is being violated. If there are no active constraints within a given interval no data will be available for that interval.

⚠️ PJM does not typically backfill this data series in the event of data drops.
description_chinese:

description: This dataset contains daily flow limits across transmission lines that provides PJM default voltage values and voltage stability limits by voltage class. description: This dataset contains all of PJM’s aggregations used in settlements. description:
Hourly load data in SPP by Area.

Released daily around 5pm CT for the previous day.

The `forecast_area_type` columns takes on two values:
* CF: Conforming load, which is load that changes in a reasonably predictable, uniform way and is mainly driven by environmental factors like temperature.
* NC: Non-conforming load, which is load that is more process driven, does not follow a predictable pattern, and therefore must be forecast separately and then added to conforming load forecasts. This also includes load representing the charging capabilities of energy storage resources not registered as an MSR.

💡 The Areas in this dataset are the legacy balancing authorities for the region that SPP serves.

forecast_area_type 列取两个值：
* CF：合规负荷，指以合理可预测、均匀方式变化的负荷，主要受温度等环境因素驱动。
* NC：非合规负荷，指更受过程驱动、不遵循可预测模式的负荷，因此必须单独预测，然后加到合规负荷预测中。该类型还包括未注册为MSR（储能资源）的储能资源的充电能力所代表的负荷。
